outcomes.single: one dominant deep-loop intent routes to one mode
outcomes.orderedBundle: clearly separate deep-loop intents route to an ordered mode list
outcomes.defer: unclear or contradictory deep-loop intent asks for disambiguation

routerPolicy.defaultResourceContract: A scored route assembles exactly the selected mode's declared resources. defaultResource is consulted only when no mode scores (zero-signal branch), and then only as the defer-time suggestion offered with the disambiguation checklist. It is never a stage-two preamble loaded on every route, and never unioned into a scored route's resource set.
routerPolicy.discoveryClassesContract: Classes listed here are hub discovery/defer evidence only. They are intentionally referenced by NO mode's scoring classes: a prompt naming only the hub (including its former identity) scores zero modes and takes the defer outcome instead of guessing a loop.
